english: When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared.
text: made themselves comfortable 说他们安顿好、让自己舒服些，不是把自己“制造”成什么。表达主动调整到某种状态，可用 make yourself comfortable；接待客人时这也常是“请随意坐、别拘束”的招呼。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
